IC1.IC1.1: Histopathological verification of glioblastoma multiforme (GBM: WHO grade IV) in remission
IC1.IC1.3: in Group A or Group B.

IC4.IC4.1: Patient or parent/guardian capable of providing informed consent
IC4.IC4.3: informed consent explained to, understood by and signed by patient/guardian.

IC5.IC5.1: Bilirubin less than 1.5x upper limit of normal
IC5.IC5.3: AST less than 3x upper limit of normal

IC6.IC6.1: Pulse oximetry of 90% or greater on room air
IC6.IC6.3: sexually active patients must be willing to utilize one of the more effective birth control methods for 6 months after the CTL infusion.

IC7.IC7.1: Patients should have been off other investigational antineoplastic therapy for one month prior to entry in this study.
IC7.IC7.3: informed consent given to, understood by and signed by patient/guardian.

EC3.EC3.1: History of hypersensitivity reactions to murine protein-containing products.
EC3.EC3.3: known allergy to any component of the CTL product.
